question: Is the already frozen H1/H4/H7 core necessary on v8, matching its newly observed sufficiency and earlier removal confirmations?

authority.scope: This is a paired removal confirmation on an already opened population, not a second independent population. The triple itself was frozen before v8.

frozen_design.population: The same 29 A1 and 31 A2 jointly capable v8 rows.
frozen_design.arms: Live writer; restore H1/H4/H7, restore the other six heads, restore all heads, and inert base self-clamp.
frozen_design.outcomes: Fraction of all projected H3 removal and signed behavioral removal.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capture_self_clamp_and_: All authorities, exact controls, complete records, and price hold.
predictions.pred_b_complete_l9_removal_is_material: All-head removal is nonzero and at least 3% of writer behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_greedy_set_is_necessary_for_h3_re: Triple removal is at least 90% of all-head H3 removal in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_complement_is_unnecessary_for_h3_: Six-head removal is at most 15% in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_greedy_set_is_necessary_for_behav: Triple behavioral removal is within 20% of all-head removal in both panels.

decision: paired_confirmation if all pass; redundant if the complete edge is material but triple necessity fails; null if complete removal is immaterial; invalid if instrumentation fails.
